name: leakguard
description: Web system for detecting leaked secrets in Git repositories

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n shared,detector,api,worker,client -c gray,magenta,blue,cyan,green "npm:dev -w @leakguard/shared" "npm:dev -w @leakguard/detector" "npm:dev -w @leakguard/server" "npm:dev:worker -w @leakguard/server" "npm:dev -w @leakguard/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
